_about: D-09 workspace seed behaviour. Ported from 01a93e17216faea7bfc156b0f864cbbe420d1c52
_method: Values produced by executing the named Python code under pi_dash.settings.test with no DB/S3 (venv /tmp/ct100-django-venv). Generators: /tmp/fx_d09b.py, /tmp/fx_d09c.py (throwaway). Seed-file reads executed against apps/api/pi_dash/seeds/data (read-only).

create_project_and_member.identifier: alnum-only chars of workspace.name, truncated to 5.
create_project_and_member.row: Project(**seed minus id/name/identifier, workspace, name=workspace.name, identifier, created_by=bot, cycle_view=module_view=issue_views_view=True); save(created_by_id, disable_auto_set_user=True).
create_project_and_member.members: ProjectMember per workspace member (member_id, role copied, workspace_id, created_by bot) via bulk_create.
create_project_and_member.user_properties: ProjectUserProperty per member with FIXED display_filters + display_properties literals (recorded verbatim below).

create_project_states: pop id/project_id; State(**seed, project_id=map[pid], workspace, created_by bot); save(...); returns {seed_id: uuid}.
create_project_labels: Same shape as states for Label.
create_project_issues: Requires id/labels/project_id/state_id keys (missing -> error log + continue); pops id/labels/project_id/state_id/cycle_id/module_ids (cycle_id/module_ids KeyError if absent — unguarded .pop, port as-is); Issue(**rest, state/map, project/map, workspace, created_by bot); IssueSequence + IssueActivity(verb/created, comment 'created the issue', epoch=time.time()) per issue; IssueLabel per label; CycleIssue iff cycle_id truthy; ModuleIssue per module_id iff truthy.
create_pages:
Page(workspace, is_global=False, access or PUBLIC, name, description_json or {}, description_html or '

', binary/stripped as-is, created/updated/owned by bot); PROJECT type with project_id -> ProjectPage row.
create_cycles: pop id/project_id/type (KeyError if type absent); CURRENT: now..now+14d; UPCOMING: last cycle end+1d..+14d else now+14d..+28d; any other type -> start_date/end_date UNBOUND -> NameError on Cycle(...) (port as-is). owned_by bot.
create_views: pop project_id + id (id DISCARDED); IssueView(**rest, project/map, workspace, created/owned by bot).

workspace_seed.bot_user: username/email bot_user_<workspace.id>(+@example.com), display/first 'Pi Dash', is_bot, bot_type WORKSPACE_SEED, password=make_password(uuid4hex), is_password_autoset.
workspace_seed.failure: broad except -> error log + RAISE (unlike most tasks which swallow).

db_before_after.before: Workspace + its WorkspaceMembers; no project rows.
db_before_after.after: 1 bot user + membership; 1 project named = workspace name; len(states) states, len(labels) labels, len(cycles) cycles, len(modules) modules, len(issues) issues (+sequences, activities, label/cycle/module links), len(views) views, len(pages) pages (+ProjectPage rows for PROJECT ones). Seed-int ids threaded via maps.
